items.source: Callback being invoked after a domain object is materialized from a CouchbaseDocument when reading results.
items.translation: 在读取结果时，回调函数在从 `CouchbaseDocument` 反序列化域对象之后被调用。

items.source: Callback being invoked before a domain object is converted to be persisted.
items.translation: 在将域对象转换为可持久化状态之前调用回调。

items.source: This package contains various events that are emitted during the lifecycle of a Spring Data entity.
items.translation: 该包包含在 Spring Data 实体生命周期期间发出的各种事件。
